purpose: Teach: 譴/發/ココログ/茲/兇/廚/李/眞

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 懲戒として譴責は形式的でも記録しましょう
lines.en: Let's document the reprimand formally, even if it's procedural.
lines.style: Crisp, efficient tone. No flourish. Direct eye contact. The voice of someone moving through a checklist with competence and speed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。旧書類の「發」の記載を電子化します
lines.en: Yes. I'll digitize the old records — the character entry specifically.
lines.style: Attentive and ready. Light nod in the voice. Confirming as he listens, not waiting to speak. Professional but present.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員のココログ運用ガイドを整えましょう
lines.en: Let's establish a clear usage policy for the company blog.
lines.style: Measured directive. Slight forward lean in the phrasing — ownership without pushiness. The tone of someone setting a standard, not issuing an order.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。「茲に契約の旨を確認する」と書面に致します
lines.en: Yes. I'll have it written as a formal confirmation of contract terms.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Takes the instruction in, then clarifies his understanding back. Calm, noting details. The rhythm of someone taking notes.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内防犯で兇器対策の研修を実施しましょう
lines.en: Let's run a security training on weapon prevention protocols.
lines.style: Clear, direct command. The voice shifts slightly — more authority, less negotiation. Deliberate pace. This one matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社食の廚房、つまり厨房スタッフの研修を強化します
lines.en: Yes. I'll strengthen the training for kitchen staff — make it a priority.
lines.style: Emphatic agreement. Picks up on the weight of the directive. Slightly faster, showing he understands the gravity. Committing out loud.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新規取引先の李社長との会食を設定しましょう
lines.en: Let's set up a dinner meeting with the new partner company president, Li.
lines.style: Smooth transition back to business development. Lighter touch now. The voice of someone moving between operational and relational modes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者ご令孫の眞さんを社内会議にお招きします
lines.en: Yes. I'll invite Shin, the founder's grandson, to the internal meeting.
lines.style: Final confirmation with a note of relationship-tending. Slight warmth on the personal detail. Closing the list with care for the human side.
